intro: Flexible day menus, not a fixed six-day itinerary. Existing confirmed bookings and arrival/departure times take precedence. New options are separate from original 94.
transit_note: Local fares and live journey times not quoted: use live rail routing. Approximate dayparts allow for queues and browsing.

options.title: Tokyo Great Cycling Tour
options.what: Guided city bicycle tours: an arranged bike, guide and route rather than navigating alone.
constraints: Prior reservation; exact Nov date availability unconfirmed.
Standard adult bikes suit about 150 cm+; e-assist +¥3,000 half day/+¥5,000 full day, only 5 bikes sized 153 cm+.
Runs in winter; weather cancellation policy applies. Return bike before any alcohol.

options.title: DIG Tokyo West-Side Cycling & Food Tour
options.what: A 3.5–4 hours small-group pedal-bike tour of residential lanes and everyday Japanese food; not major monuments.
constraints: Roughly 12–15 km; confident riding required.
Small-group riders over 10 years and 140 cm; helmets free on request.
Food stops do not cater for allergies/dietary needs.
Usually proceeds in rain with ponchos; do not assume automatic cancellation.

options.title: TOKYOBIKE TOKYO rental
options.what: Independent standard pedal bicycle rental for coffee shops and local backstreet exploring.
constraints: Book up to 30 days ahead; photo ID; reserve each rider’s size.
Return to same shop; rental hours Wed–Fri 11:00–17:30, Sat/Sun 10:00–17:30.
Closed Mon/Tue: not Nov 16. Fleet availability unconfirmed.

options.title: Tokyobike Yanaka Soil rental
options.what: Independent pedal-bike rental for old-Tokyo neighbourhood lanes; shop return required.
constraints: Closed Tue/Wed/Thu: not Nov 11–12.
Photo ID and bike-size reservation recommended. Confirm rental hand-back time on booking.

options.title: Docomo Tokyo Bike Share
options.what: Electric-assist bikes for short local hops; less dependable for securing an entire group fleet.
options.price: ¥165/30 min; ¥1,650 convenience-store day pass; ¥2,200 staffed IC-card day pass
constraints: Convenience-store pass requires SMS; verify phone compatibility.
IC pass requires contactable phone + photo ID; locate staffed seller first.
Return only at supported port and confirm completion; stock/hours vary.
Pass ends 23:59 same day, not 24 hours.

options.title: Shinjuku Gyoen
options.what: Japanese and landscaped gardens: a calm daylight break before neon Shinjuku.
constraints: November 09:00–16:30, last entry 16:00.
Open daily Nov 1–15; CLOSED Mon Nov 16.
Do not promise peak autumn foliage.

options.title: Tokyo National Museum
options.what: Japanese art, Buddhist sculpture and historic objects: an indoor cultural anchor.
constraints: 09:30–17:00; Fri/Sat until 20:00, last entry 30 min before.
CLOSED Mon Nov 16. Honkan Room 4 closed during trip, not entire museum.
Online collection ticket recommended; not a fixed-time slot.

options.title: Kiyosumi Gardens
options.what: A strolling pond garden with ornamental rocks and stepping stones; explore on foot after parking legally.
constraints: 09:00–17:00, last entry 16:30; no regular weekly closure.

options.title: Sunshine Aquarium
options.what: Rooftop aquarium near home base; indoor tanks plus weather-exposed rooftop exhibits.
constraints: Autumn/winter generally weekdays 10:00–18:00, weekends 09:30–18:00; last 30 min before.
Recheck exact November calendar; weekend timed reservations recommended.

packages.title: Shrine, fashion lanes & Shibuya lights
packages.travel: Rail Ikebukuro→Harajuku; walk corridor to Shibuya; rail home. Check live transit.
packages.budget_note: Free shrine/crossing; food, shopping and Shibuya Sky extra. Do not treat this as an all-in price.

sequence.title: Shibuya Sky
sequence.what: Rooftop city view, only if a slot is secured.

must_book: Shibuya Sky desired slot; meals with reservations remain subject to existing tracker.
constraints: Approximate dayparts, not a timed booking. Do not attempt every clothing shop.
packages.rain_alternative: Shorten shrine walk; spend more time in PARCO and indoor fashion shops.

packages.title: Garden daylight & Shinjuku neon
packages.travel: Rail Ikebukuro→Shinjuku, then local walking; rail home.
packages.budget_note: Known garden admission ¥500/person; ramen, batting and bars extra.

sequence.title: Godzilla Head
sequence.what: Street-level photo; terrace access not assumed.

sequence.title: Golden Gai
sequence.what: Tiny bars, not a large nightclub district.

constraints: Garden CLOSED Nov 16; enter by 16:00 other dates.
Closed Gaien batting/golf is deliberately excluded.
packages.rain_alternative: Cafés, ramen and indoor shops instead of garden; keep evening lanes optional.

packages.title: Old Tokyo & the river skyline
packages.travel: Rail from Ikebukuro with transfer to Asakusa; local walk/rail to Oshiage; rail home.
packages.budget_note: Temple grounds/walking free; food and Skytree admission extra.

sequence.title: Asakusa
sequence.what: Choose a local Japanese lunch; specific restaurant not selected.

sequence.title: Tokyo Skytree
sequence.what: Observation tower; Solamachi below for gifts, character goods and food.

must_book: Skytree timed slot if going up.
constraints: Do not also add Ueno and Akihabara to this full day.
Poor weather may obscure observation views.
packages.rain_alternative: Short temple visit then more time inside Solamachi shops.

packages.title: West-side cycling & vintage clothing
packages.travel: Ikebukuro→Shinjuku→Koenji by JR; choose a service that stops at Koenji.
packages.budget_note: Tour from ¥14,000/person; rail, dinner and clothing purchases extra.

sequence.title: DIG Tokyo West-Side Cycling & Food Tour
sequence.what: Allow 3.5–4 hours for riding and everyday Japanese food.

sequence.title: Koenji Look Street / Pal arcade
sequence.what: Covered shopping lanes; vintage clothing nearby.

sequence.title: Koenji
sequence.what: Relaxed local dinner after returning bikes.

must_book: DIG tour slot and rider sizes.
constraints: Tour generally runs in rain; confirm cancellation terms.
Return bicycles before drinking; don’t add another far-side district.
packages.rain_alternative: If changing within operator terms, use covered Pal arcade and vintage shops instead.

packages.title: Local bikes, coffee & a pond garden
packages.travel: Rail from Ikebukuro to Kiyosumi-Shirakawa with transfer; ride locally, not from hotel.
packages.budget_note: Known rental+garden ¥2,650/person; coffee, food and rail extra.

sequence.title: TOKYOBIKE TOKYO rental
sequence.what: Collect reserved size, confirm legal local route and return time.

sequence.title: Kiyosumi-Shirakawa
sequence.what: Coffee shops and backstreet loop toward Fukagawa; choose route with staff.

sequence.title: Kiyosumi Gardens
sequence.what: Pond garden on foot, last entry 16:30.

constraints: Rental closed Mon Nov 16.
Published rental end 17:30; return earlier to reach garden.
Alternative: choose a TGCT half-day tour, not both operators in one day.
packages.rain_alternative: Tokyo National Museum + Akihabara retro games/figures/arcades instead (museum closed Nov 16); on Nov 16 use Sunshine City near home base.

fuji.title: Optional Fuji: only for clear weather
fuji.what: A whole-day lake-and-mountain-view excursion, not climbing Mt Fuji.
fuji.recommendation: Default to Tokyo on a five-day trip. Replace one Tokyo day only if near-date forecast and morning live view are clear and both transport legs work. No November visibility forecast is claimed now.
fuji.transport: Ikebukuro→Shinjuku JR, then Busta 4 F via New South Gate. Direct coach headline about 1 hour 45 minutes; traffic can extend it. Budget roughly 2.5–3 hours each way from Ikebukuro including transfers as a planning allowance, not timetable.
fuji.price: Coach ¥2,000 one-way online Fujiyama Connect / ¥2,200 counter; local rail, buses and food extra.
fuji.booking: Reserved seats; same-day online offered subject to availability. Secure the return too. No booking made.
fuji.rail_alternative: FUJI EXCURSION fastest 1 hour 53 minutes Shinjuku→Kawaguchiko, assigned-seat booking recommended; through fare must be checked, not outdated 2024 ¥4,130. Tickets generally open 10:00 JST one month ahead.
sequence: Local bus to lakeshore / Oishi Park for Fuji across the lake
Lunch: consider hoto, wide wheat noodles and vegetables in miso broth; restaurant unselected
constraints: Full day opportunity cost; skip if cloudy.
No summit climbing: official summit trails closed out of season.
Local bus times/fares need recheck; do not squeeze ropeway and pagoda into same simple plan.
fuji.cloudy_alternative: Shinjuku Gyoen + Shinjuku or Tokyo National Museum + Akihabara Nov 11–15. On Nov 16 stay close with Ikebukuro Sunshine City.

safety.text: Ride left on roadways; sidewalks only where permitted, pedestrians first. Obey lights and stops, use lights at night, wear a helmet, never cycle after alcohol. Stop before using navigation.

excluded.title: Wakasu bicycle rentals
excluded.reason: Closed for renovations until expected April 2027.
